text:
julian-support: FYI brief escalation from ContourAI — they see intermittent 429s on their Dedicated pool despite reserved capacity. started ~09:10 UTC.

maria-oncall: any quick context? is this noisy-neighbor or quota?

julian-support: customer reports spikes when they run batch embed job. logs show per-tenant throttle keys hitting limits. sample log: `2026-03-16T09:12:23Z ERROR rate_limiter: tenant=contourai id=tn-847 429 unit_exhausted`

julian-support: i grabbed their quota config from the tenant record, looks odd — suspect unit mismatch.

sasha-runtime: paste the config? sometimes plan migration leaves old unit enum.

julian-support: here it is:
```
tenant_id: tn-847
plan: dedicated-standard
quota: 3600
quota_units: minutes
rate_limit: 600
rate_units: minute
```

julian-support: they expected `quota` to be tokens/min but platform interprets `quota` as per-second units for dedicated mapping. think it's the minutes vs seconds translation bug we saw in april.

arya-sre: that mapping bug rings a bell. ops-bot, do we have a detector for mismatched unit enums on tenant configs?

ops-bot: alert created: #config-schema-mismatch (auto) — tenant tn-847 flagged for unit mismatch (quota_units vs expected_units).

maria-oncall: ok route: set temporary override to align units, confirm if autoscaler had spare capacity but rate limiter blocked. arya — can you check pool saturation at the time window? pool id = gpud-qs-07

arya-sre: checking metrics — gpud-qs-07 had < 40% utilization during spikes. so not noisy neighbor. rate limiter per-tenant was at 100% enforcement.

kevin-billing: if quota was set to 3600 minutes unintentionally that increases allowed usage not decreases. but if interpreted as seconds, that is 3600s = 1h window vs intended 3600min = 60h -> actually more confusing. need canonical example.

julian-support: i think operator entered `quota_units: minutes` but platform expected `quota_units: requests_per_second` when mapping dedicated plans. result: limit became much lower than customer expected -> caused 429s.

sasha-runtime: reproducing locally: updated tenant mapping with wrong enum -> immediate 429s on bursty requests. repro steps:
1) set tenant.rate_units = "minute" but platform mapper expects "second"
2) send 100 concurrent requests burst
3) observe `rate_limiter::throttle` increments and 429s within 2-3s

sasha-runtime: logs snippet while reproducing:
```
[09:12:23] rate_limiter: tenant=tn-847 allowed=2/600 window=1s -> throttle++
[09:12:24] requests: 120 conns, kvcache hit 0.2, latency p95 420ms
```

maria-oncall: action items:
- julian: request tenant config export from account team + ask customer to pause heavy batch job if possible. (in progress)
- arya: push temp override mapping for tn-847 to correct units (manual fix) and monitor 10m (in progress)
- sasha: add a unit-enum validator in config ingestion pipeline (todo)
- kevin: confirm any billing impact if we change quota mapping retroactively (pending)

julian-support: i already asked customer to pause. they said they can pause next run in ~30m.

arya-sre: temp override applied at 09:18 UTC -> immediate drop in 429s, customer reports success. will keep override for 24h and roll a safe migration.

kevin-billing: quick note — if we increase effective allowance retroactively, reconcile usage credits? filing a ticket with finance to evaluate customer goodwill. ticket created: FIN-4821.

julian-support: customer very appreciative. said they could see 429s went away after override.

sasha-runtime: follow-up: i'll add unit-conversion check in the mapper + a fail-open for dedicated when pool utilization < 50% to avoid blocking due to config mismatch. PR draft by EOD.

arya-sre: also adding a kpi alert: if tenant 429 rate > 1% and pool utilization < 60% -> auto-flag config mismatch. prevents hunting.

maria-oncall: thanks team. i'll keep this thread updated. julian, set status to "monitoring" and close after 48h stable. :white_check_mark:

julian-support: monitoring. closing plan: 48h watch -> apply mapper patch -> run migration job for any tenants with nonstandard units -> ops will notify customers.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: check tn-847 override expiry in 23h 50m.

maria-oncall: note for postmortem: source = config ingestion unit enum mismatch (human entry + missing validator). severity P2 for now since fix was quick.

julian-support: will draft short postmortem and link to FIN-4821 and PR when ready.

maria-oncall: great, thanks everyone.
